name: aida
description: AI Development Agents (AIDA) - Agentic framework for autonomous project execution with human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Coordinates specialized sub-agents through a research → plan → execute → test (watchdog) → review pipeline with a review-before-commit gate and an escape-catalog learning loop.

skills.name: orchestrating-agents
skills.description: Core workflow for project planning and execution. Coordinates research, planning, execution, and review sub-agents.

skills.name: mapping-codebase
skills.description: Parallel codebase analysis skill. Spawns 4 parallel agents to produce 7 structured reference documents.

commands.name: progress
commands.description: Check project status, show metrics, and route to next action

commands.name: new-project
commands.description: Initialize a new project with PROJECT.md and planning structure

commands.name: map-codebase
commands.description: Analyze codebase with parallel agents, produce 7 reference documents

commands.name: create-roadmap
commands.description: Create a phased roadmap from PROJECT.md

commands.name: plan-phase
commands.description: Research and create a detailed execution plan for a specific phase

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Run full verification suite (type checking, tests, lint)

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Save a context handoff when pausing, or resume work from a previous session

commands.name: issues
commands.description: Log a deferred issue, or triage the deferred-issue backlog

agents.name: researcher
agents.description: Explores codebase to gather context for phase planning

agents.name: planner
agents.description: Creates detailed phase execution plans from research findings

agents.name: executor
agents.description: Executes plan segments autonomously; stages work, does not commit

agents.name: test-writer-fixer
agents.description: Independent test watchdog between executor and reviewer; makes tests real, flags product bugs

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Verifies completion, audits process, logs escapes, marks APPROVED

installation.postInstall: echo '✅ AIDA plugin installed! 2 skills, 9 commands, 5 agents ready. Restart Claude Code.'
